JonathanTrustATrader review

I had a lot of slipped and damaged slates, rotten barge board that need replacing and the the ridge tiles that needed re pointing. The guys came out promptly to view and quote and soon after came to do the work. They even painted the replacement barge board which saved having to hire a painter and offered to do the main barge board down the side of the house. After being in a serious accident this was a huge relief to have everything fixed and ready for winter. Great guys who are friendly,polite, punctual, professional and tell you everything about the process that you understand. Highly recommend them and if I have any roof issues in the future, they will be the people!
